summary.answer: Creates shared Director select screen with extra-home left/right filtered lists, featured playlists, mode list, safe-area/description and PC/Korea/tier-notification children. List callbacks refresh labels on lock/trial/lobby changes and descriptions on focus. Extra/mode trial-store branches containing AlwaysFalse are retained as inactive source predicates; unlocked/show-for-all/not-trial actions process the list and return true. Featured prioritizes trial store, unlocked action, missing-DLC overlay, ZM store, season-pass upsell and locked action. Mode locked action is PC-gated. Focus/lose-focus shows/hides tier notification. Safe-area menu_loaded sizes console and dispatches when unhandled. Korea event controls use exact active-event branches. State predicates distinguish live online demo/arena/default and LAN demo/arena/default. Close/postload precede pass-custom-function, UGC validation, WZ trial-video and PC redirect navigation setup. No effective playlist choice, store action, account state or native loader/runtime is asserted.

summary.answer: Gets the engine experiment array for controller argument0 and iterates indices1 through its length in order. Only entries with startsInSeconds==0 and endsInSeconds>0 are searched. If rules is non-nil and not empty, first tries the exact whitespace-after-colon quoted-value Lua pattern and returns a nonempty capture. Otherwise tries the literal colon-plus pattern and returns a nonempty capture. Continues to later entries on no capture; returns empty string after exhaustion. This is pattern matching rather than a JSON parse; key pattern metacharacters are not escaped and the second pattern is not silently corrected. summary.answer: Only a truthy DDL-like first argument triggers two ClearDDLKeysAndArrays requests, in literal source sequence. The second request follows the first return and has no rollback. Return immediately for a falsey row list or destination. Otherwise traverse ipairs rows, write destination[index-1] using a native hash conversion of row[key] or EmptyItemIndex. A truthy destination and truthy item hash can produce a conversion, optional fallback conversion, set request and explicit result. The recovered trailing assignment is outside the local declaration scope; it does not set the destination or return EmptyItemIndex. Populate primary/secondary attachment and item fields, then grenade; additional ZM and MP branches use literal mode guards. Preserve duplicate secondary write, optional fourth-argument arithmetic and possible nil comparisons/returns. Request the hashed storage buffer. Nil buffer returns false; otherwise a nested StatValue:get greater than zero returns true and all other comparable results return false. Return the direct result of Dvar hash_20997C814ED4B7ED:get without existence test, coercion or default. Use the specialized DLC query only when the dvar exists, its value is truthy and main mode is MP or WZ; otherwise request getdlcbits with no forwarded arguments. Make a fresh result list; for nonnil/nonempty input, append converted tokens matched by [^%s;]+ in iteration order and return the list. For nonnil/nonempty blacklist text, return true at the first nonempty token whose native converted hash equals arg0; otherwise return false. Assign a fresh outer table whose keys field is a fresh ordered string array: killstreak1, killstreak2, killstreak3, killstreak4. It does not set actual loadout slots or grant anything.
